seed.note: A minimal synthetic DataProcessor (ChartFormTest) with one Form carrying a single Chart-typed attribute (ChartField bound to it), built from the shape of two already-proven realSeriesCount=0 UT examples (Catalogs/ВариантыАнализаЦелевыхПоказателей/Forms/НастройкаДемоДанных, InformationRegisters/СезонныеКоэффициенты/Forms/СезонныеКоэффициенты). One control at realSeriesCount=0, one variant adding a single realSeriesData record ahead of the fixed realExSeriesData placeholder (realSeriesCount=1), one variant adding four (ids 2,3,4,6, mirroring native UT DataProcessors/ПроверкаКонтрагента/Forms/Форма's own ДиаграммаПоказателей attribute, id=5 skipped) -- each seed's whole tree round-tripped through ibcmd 8.3.27.2214 itself.

objects.variant: realSeriesCount=1, one realSeriesData (id=2) ahead of realExSeriesData (id=1)
realSeriesCount=4, four realSeriesData (ids 2,3,4,6) ahead of realExSeriesData (id=1)

proven_claims: realSeriesCount real realSeriesData records (11 members each, same shape push_moxel_chart_series_text_xml already reads) precede the single, always-present realExSeriesData placeholder -- not the other way around, and not a replacement of it.

The tail past rebuildTime grows by exactly 3 members per real series when point_count=0, matching moxel.rs's own `197 + 3*series_count + point_count*(1+4*series_count)` formula for the spreadsheet-document chart's tail -- confirmed at series_count=1 and series_count=4 by exact byte round-trip (cf export produces the platform's own native XML unchanged), not merely by length arithmetic.

The growth splits into a count field (`1+series_count`) plus two `(1+series_count)`-long lists right after rebuildTime (a `{0,<id>,0}` id list -- ex-series id first, then each real series id in declared order -- and a `{0,0}` list), plus one extra copy of an otherwise-unclaimed funnel-link-shaped record appearing later in the tail.

The series record's marker slot is not moxel_chart_marker's 0..3 shape enum: chart-form-1series's real series reads marker=3 while its ex-series placeholder reads marker=1, and both round-trip to the literal <d4p1:marker>Auto</d4p1:marker> -- the slot is validated as an integer and never rendered, the same treatment the writer already gives the series colour.

The isTransposed/autoTransposition/legendScrollEnable and titleIsInit/legendIsInit/chartIsInit literal trios' old guard slots (t[82..85), t[88..93)'s 88/89/92) are not those flags' real storage: with a real series present they hold design-time legend/plot-area floats instead (same unclaimed family as the spreadsheet-document chart's own tail[84]/tail[86]/tail[87]), so the guard is dropped rather than repointed -- all three seeds still write the same literals regardless.
non_claims: Point records (point_count>0) are not exercised by any variant here; the point_count*(1+4*series_count) term of the tail-growth formula is carried over unverified from moxel.rs, not independently proven for a form chart attribute.

chartType codes other than Column3D (6), splineMode, pointsScale/seriesScale/valuesScale, legendPlacement's third value (Bottom), titleAreaPlacement, valuesToolTipShowMode, pointsDropLinesShowMode and pointsDropLinesShowMode/valuesDropLinesShowMode remain unclaimed -- native UT's own DataProcessors/ПроверкаКонтрагента/Forms/Форма (realSeriesCount=4, chartType=Line) still does not round-trip; this fixture closes only the series-count/marker/guard defects, not the whole remainder item.
